title: Labor organization consultation.
bodyText: Any activity under this chapter which provides service to a substantial number of members of a labor organization shall be conducted only after full consultation with the appropriate labor organization.
bodyHtml: [§394B-7]  Labor organization consultation.  Any activity under this chapter which provides service to a substantial number of members of a labor organization shall be conducted only after full consultation with the appropriate labor organization. [L 1983, c 195, pt of §1]
